name: Neuquén
shape: geoBoundaries, the province it is named for

climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: An Argentine wine area with two places inside it, Añelo and Confluencia.

sources.name: Fick and Hijmans 2017, WorldClim 2.1 monthly averages for 1970 to 2000, 2.5 minute grid (about 4.5 km)
Beck et al. 2023, High-resolution (1 km) Koppen-Geiger maps, Scientific Data (1991 to 2020)
Winkler, Cook, Kliewer and Lider 1974, General Viticulture, University of California Press (heat summation regions)

ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0, 1 km aggregates, 30 to 60 cm depth (CC BY 4.0)
USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual, Agriculture Handbook 18 (texture classes and pH classes)
Anderson, Nelgen and Puga, Database of Regional, National and Global Winegrape Bearing Areas by Variety, 2000 to 2023, University of Adelaide (CC BY 4.0)
Vitis International Variety Catalogue (VIVC), Julius Kühn-Institut: varieties listed only as table or raisin grapes
AWS Terrain Tiles (Terrarium), from SRTM, GMTED2010, ETOPO1 and national elevation models
Wikipedia, Lapse rate (6.5 °C cooler per 1,000 m, the standard atmosphere)
